rules: File-level provenance of every image the v6.3 landscape page can draw (SPEC §12, survey_assets §5, assets/PROVENANCE.txt, assets/v6/PROVENANCE_v6.md). 'block' = the URL patterns blocked in the provenance run (CDP Network.setBlockedURLs), so the page falls back to its own drawing. A layer whose pixels change between the full and the blocked run contains blocked pixels: the full layer goes to MenuV6Local/, the blocked-run layer is its tracked fallback (BUILD_PLAN D7). First match wins in 'files'.
decisions: Ground truth = the live v6.3 page: the 16 approved sheet stills re-render bit-exact through the exporter (check/stills.json), so every part, rect and timeline is read from those pages
Sheets reveal by the Puzzle-lock clip (no line draw-on, no dissolve); SPEC §8.5 / §8.6 timings superseded by the page's (reveal, duel beats)

Over the Stone: recess / Ring / QUIT frames ship as exact full bakes at their stage rects; every other rect (map hosts, BuildFrame sheets) = frame9 (Sliced) + the lintel tiles (Tiled) + frame9_l1 / l2 (Sliced)

Lintel star tiles = 340 px of the recess sheet's own star field (the page skips 35 % of stars at random): a tiled lintel repeats every 340 px; the odd-row stagger follows the recess frame (absolute-y parity)

Map hosts = MenuChromePrefs.GetWindowAnchors Compact / Medium / Large (non-AR) of the screen in stage px; the lintel = the recess sheet's (108 land / 150 port); QuietFill alpha caps apply to the fill only (the lines and lintel stay opaque, as on the page)

QUIT (no mockup page): the recess frame look at a decided rect centred on the door (land 700 x 400 at (610, 356), port 900 x 660), title in the Ring sheet's header type (#rov .h), the body in #sht .txt, STAY = the .sig .stay gold plate, FOLD = the .quit carnelian plate, both 220 x 64 (port 280 x 76) with the .quit .t type; copy = DuelDiskMenuUI.cs:484-489 (P1a); it runs the recess Puzzle-lock timeline (every v6.3 sheet does); the torch gutter = the flame strength x (1 - .55 win(u, 0, .12, .28, .4)) (the page's own omen gutter factor .55, menu.js:668); no Kuriboh mew (no asset)
FrameGhost plays the page's close curves (~0.7 s + the pieces home), not SPEC §8.6's 0.35 s

Cards: the faces and back as displayed (Konami frames / back -> MenuV6Local); tracked fallbacks = the clean run's faces (the page's own card base #111 + own art + text; VS PLAYER without its RIP art) and a plain slate back (#1E1A23 + the ink ring)
The armed row's box icon is the golden-box render (licence unknown) -> local, no fallback (hidden)
Data (BUILD_PLAN §7): ledger rows only with a real source (LEDGER); the Ring sheet hides the '1.2 mi … (sample)' line and uses the real Tear count; SETTINGS opens SettingsScreen (D12)
The Ring echo stays untappable (D12): no locator sheet is exported
His eye in the Ring sheet's Tear sliver: his own layers through the page (anime_v61_eye.js), gaze forced 0 (straight out), exported as a 13-cell flipbook of k
